subject.title: Device pairing: bind setup codes to node approvals

question: Should this protected maintainer PR be closed as superseded by the merged profile-based QR/setup-code bootstrap handoff work, or should it be reworked on top of current main?
rationale: The maintainer label and MEMBER author prevent automatic close, and the remaining choice is ownership/direction for an auth-boundary PR rather than a narrow automated repair.

options.title: Close As Superseded
options.body: Close this PR and point to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/83684 plus https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/85690 as the current owner of the setup-code bootstrap contract.

options.title: Rework On Current Main
options.body: Keep the PR only if a maintainer wants Vincent or another owner to rebuild it around PAIRING_SETUP_BOOTSTRAP_PROFILE and current profile redemption state.

options.title: Keep For Separate Direction
options.body: Keep it open only if maintainers intentionally want a new node-only setup-code policy despite the documented mobile handoff contract.

recommendation.title: Close As Superseded
recommendation.body: Close this PR and point to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/83684 plus https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/85690 as the current owner of the setup-code bootstrap contract.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the current PR and has prior setup-code bootstrap history, so he is the best first person to decide whether to close or revive the branch.
